summary: Glance is a personal dashboard designed to centralise various web feeds into a single interface. It allows you to organise and monitor multiple content streams from one place using a customisable layout. The application is packaged as a Docker container.
goodFor: It suits users who want to consolidate diverse web feeds and personal monitoring widgets into a single, self-hosted browser page.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence requires you to make the source code available if you modify the software and run it as a network service. Additionally, highly customisable dashboard tools often require manual YAML or configuration editing rather than offering fully graphical setup.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based Go application, it typically requires a persistent volume mounted for configuration storage and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination. It generally runs as a lightweight container without needing a separate database backend.
